[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/01] The user put only the submission deadline in the calendar and missed the application deadline by one day because they did not check the issuance period.

[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/01] Staff at a public-service counter expect a person requesting identity verification to bring an original as well as a copy.

[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/01] The local agent cannot determine the current validity of an identity document without its expiration date.

[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/02] After changing the same content into a checklist, the user marked every item they had prepared.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/02] The user called their mother on a weekend evening, but they spoke only briefly because the mother was out.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/02] The user called again on Saturday morning the following week and spoke for 40 minutes.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/02] The user sent a text to an old number for an emergency contact and saw that delivery failed.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/02] After confirming the new number with their older sister, the user updated the contact list.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/02] For nonurgent contact, the user's older sister prefers to reply by text when available rather than take a call immediately.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/02] Before using an emergency contact, reconfirm the number and relationship information with the user.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/02] The user feels that a reminder the day before an appointment gives them enough time to recheck preparation items.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/03] The user stores prepared meals on the second shelf of the freezer.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/03] The user went to the market without a shopping list and bought onions that were already at home.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/03] On a day the user shopped after checking a refrigerator photo, they did not make a duplicate purchase.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/03] On a day the user made a spicy stew, they left part of one bowl uneaten.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/03] The next time the user cooked it, they used half as much chili powder and finished the meal.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/03] When cooking with their younger brother, the user assigned the cooking sequence only verbally and they did the same task twice.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/03] The next time, the user and their younger brother split ingredient preparation and heat control and finished the meal 20 minutes earlier.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/03] When cooking together, the user's younger brother prefers to divide the cooking and dishwashing roles in advance.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/03] The local agent can compare responses across several meals, but it cannot conclude from one unfinished food item that the user dislikes that ingredient.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/03] The condition of frozen prepared food may vary with its packaging and storage duration.

[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/04] The user went downstairs 25 minutes after the laundry finished and received a note from another household.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/04] For the next load, the user set a reminder five minutes before the end and removed the laundry immediately.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/04] The user washed light-colored clothes with new jeans, and color transferred onto white socks.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/04] The user later washed the new jeans separately, and the color of the other clothes did not change.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/04] On a day the user did not check the dryer filter, the clothes needed another drying cycle.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/04] On the next use, after emptying the filter, the user finished drying in one cycle.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/04] The building manager judges that not leaving finished laundry for a long time is fair to other households.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/04] When creating a shared laundry-room reminder, base it on the end time of the machine the user started.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/04] Even if the local agent knows where the card is kept, it cannot know which machines in the shared laundry room are currently available.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/05] The user keeps two potted herbs beside a south-facing window.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/05] During a week when the user watered every day based only on the soil surface, the leaves of one plant turned yellow.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/05] During a week when the user checked below the soil surface with a finger before watering, the plant grew new leaves.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/05] On a day the user left the window open for a long time, strong wind knocked over one pot.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/05] The next day, the user moved the pot inward from the windowsill so the same wind would not knock it over.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/05] The user put a plant-name label in a small pot received from their maternal aunt.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/05] The user confused the care instructions for an unlabeled pot with those for another plant.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/05] The user's maternal aunt considers understanding the sunlight at a pot's location more important than watering frequency when caring for it.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/05] Before creating a plant-care reminder, check each plant's name and most recent watering date.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/05] The soil in the user's potted herbs beside the south-facing window dries at different rates depending on the season and amount of sunlight.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/06] The user keeps a portable fan charger on a living-room shelf.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/06] On a hot day, the user worked with only the window open and lost focus in the afternoon.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/06] In the room where the user closed the curtains the next morning, the temperature rose less.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/06] The user took the portable fan out without charging it, and it turned off after an hour.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/06] Before the next outing, the user charged it the night before and used the fan throughout the trip.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/06] On a hot weekend, the user was eating lunch in their father's yard and moved indoors.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/06] When the user returned to the yard in the evening, shade and wind led them to stay another hour.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/06] The user's father prefers to move an outdoor meal to the evening rather than proceed at midday when the temperature is high.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/06] The local agent can compare past responses to heat but cannot know the current felt temperature without an indoor temperature record.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/06] A room with a west-facing window can warm rapidly in the late afternoon.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/07] The user keeps a travel power bank in the first drawer beneath the desk.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/07] The user packed three pairs of shoes for a two-night trip but wore only one pair.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/07] For the next two-night trip, the user packed only one pair of walking shoes and reduced the bag's weight.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/07] On a trip when the user forgot a charging cable, they bought a new one after arrival.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/07] Before the next trip, the user checked charging items against a photo and packed all of them.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/07] The user packed toiletries on the departure day and arrived 15 minutes late at the meeting place.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/07] The next time, the user closed the bag the night before and departed on time.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/07] The user's older sister considers it safer to pack an extra cable even for a short trip to avoid charging problems.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/07] When creating a travel preparation list, confirm the trip length and actual activities with the user.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/07] The local agent cannot establish what the next trip requires from the luggage used on the previous trip alone.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/08] The user keeps packing tape for returns in an upper kitchen drawer.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/08] The user arrived ten minutes before the post office closed and found that numbered-ticket intake had ended.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/08] Before the next visit, the user checked the operating hours and arrived one hour before closing.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/08] The user went to the counter without closing a return box and had to go back to the packing station.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/08] For the next return, the user sealed the box at home and completed intake in one attempt.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/08] The user scheduled bank and post-office errands for the same day, but they took a long time because the destinations were in different directions.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/08] The following week, after checking the locations on a map, the user visited nearby branches in sequence.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/08] Postal staff expect a return-label barcode to arrive affixed flat, without a fold.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/08] Before grouping errands into one outing, check each institution's location and operating hours that day.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/08] Postal and financial counters may operate on different hours than usual around public holidays.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/09] The user keeps the book they are reading and a note-taking notebook on a small living-room desk.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/09] While reading in the living room with the television on, the user read the same paragraph three times.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/09] The next day, after turning off the television, the user read 40 pages without interruption.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/09] On a day the phone was on the desk, the user stopped taking notes each time they checked a notification.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/09] During the next reading period, the user left the phone in another room and did not check it for an hour.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/09] A note attached to a paper book fell out, and the user had to find their place again.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/09] With the next book, the user recorded the page number in the notebook and resumed reading immediately.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/09] The user's father expects that lowering the television volume while the user reads will make it easier for the user to concentrate.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/09] The local agent can summarize past reading environments and interruption records but cannot predict the next reading time.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/09] The user feels that repeated notifications interrupt their flow of concentration.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/10] The user keeps waterproof shoes for rainy days to the left of the entrance.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/10] On a day the user walked in the rain wearing thin shoes, their socks became wet and they changed them after arrival.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/10] On the next rainy day, the user wore waterproof shoes and their feet remained dry.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/10] On a day the user walked for a long time in new shoes, their heel chafed and they shortened the route home.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/10] The user wore the same shoes on two short outings before using them on a long walk.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/10] On a day the user dried an umbrella outside the entrance, they found it immediately before the next outing.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/10] On a day the user put a folded wet umbrella in their bag, documents inside became wet.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/10] When rain is forecast, the user's mother expects the user may forget an umbrella and sets out a spare at the entrance.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/10] When proposing a long-distance walking plan, check both the weather that day and recent records of shoe discomfort.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/10] Even if the local agent knows a shoe's location, it cannot know its current condition or whether it is usable.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/11] The user recorded a family dinner in the calendar for the final week of November.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/11] In a crowded restaurant, the user had to ask several times for orders to be repeated, interrupting the flow of conversation.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/11] When the user held the next gathering at their father's home, they continued the conversation on the sofa after the meal.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/11] At a gathering with loud music prepared by their older sister, the user developed a headache and went outside briefly.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/11] On a day the user held a yard barbecue with their younger brother, the open space dispersed the sound and made conversation easier.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/11] After seeing a message that their maternal aunt would arrive at 5 p.m., the user delayed meal preparation by an hour.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/11] On a day the user waited without knowing their maternal uncle's arrival time, they reheated the food twice.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/11] The user's maternal uncle considers it easier to time his departure when he knows the family meal's start time in advance.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/11] Before scheduling a family meal, confirm the attendees' arrival times and the location with the user.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/11] Available restaurant reservation times may diminish quickly during the year-end gathering season.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/12] The user stores wrapping paper and empty gift boxes on the upper shelf of the bedroom closet.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/12] From photographs, the user discovered that they had given their mother the same type of kitchen item two years in a row.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/12] This year, the user went to the market with their mother and let her choose a needed item directly.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/12] The user once ordered a gift late and had it delivered the day after the gathering.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/12] The next year, the user checked the expected delivery date and ordered one week before the gathering.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/12] The user did not put names on wrapped boxes and handed their older sister and younger brother each other's gifts.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/12] The next time the user wrapped gifts, they wrote the recipient on the bottom of each box.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/12] The user's younger brother welcomes a snack the family can share immediately more than an item for his use alone.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/12] The local agent can find past gift records and flag duplicates but cannot know what is needed this year.
[task-3/local/personal-memory/2025/12] Year-end deliveries may take longer than usual or have their expected dates changed.
The user keeps four folding chairs for family barbecues in storage.
When six family members gathered in a noisy indoor restaurant, the user asked several times for the person across from them to repeat what was said.
The user held the next gathering in their father's yard and moved between seats while speaking with everyone.
On a day the user started the barbecue at midday, sunlight led them to finish the meal quickly.
The next time, the user started at 6 p.m. and remained outside until sunset.
Because the side dishes brought by the user's mother and older sister had no labels, the user opened the same container twice.
At the next gathering, the user wrote each food's name and who brought it on a small piece of paper.
After a barbecue, the user's younger brother prefers to divide leftover food into small containers to take home rather than discard it.
The local agent can summarize preparation and responses from prior family barbecues but cannot know the next attendees or weather.
The user's father's yard receives strong direct sunlight at midday; after 6 p.m., shade and wind lower the felt temperature.

analysis.overview: The frames align on noisy indoor gatherings, conversation-friendly family venues, and the advantage of evening over midday use of the father’s yard. The reference otherwise spans many personal routines, while the compared frame adds barbecue equipment, food labeling, leftovers, and event-specific uncertainty.
